summary: PreToolUse handler wired by init.ts with matcher `Bash|mcp__coldstart__find`, so it runs on EVERY Bash call — but it is only a dedup guard for `coldstart find`, not an anti-grep mechanism: canonicalFindKey(cmd) returns null for any non-find command and the handler returns null immediately, so grep/rg/git-grep/find shell through untouched with no output. Anti-grep spiral coverage lives in the PostToolUse nudge-handler.mjs instead (fires on tool==="Grep" or Bash matching SEARCH_RE), i.e. coldstart reacts AFTER the grep is paid for, never before. Denies only an exact repeat of a term-set+flags already run successfully this session (state in /tmp/find_nudge_{sid}_{aid}.json, written by the PostToolUse hook); fail-open on any error.
